styleException.description: TimePickerClock's dial label positions (style: "left: {left}%; top: {top}%;") and its clock hand's rotation (style: "...transform: rotate({hand_degrees}deg);") at time_picker.rs
styleException.reason: Each hour/minute label's position and the hand's angle are computed at runtime from the selected value's angle (dial_label_position / hand_degrees); Tailwind has no static utility for an arbitrary runtime percentage offset or rotation, matching resizable.rs's and theme_builder.rs's identical precedent for computed runtime placement.

radiusException.reason: TimePickerTrigger is a small disclosure button, not the field's own surface -- matches DatePickerTrigger's identical exception.
the [role=spinbutton] descendant selector is an arbitrary-variant selector targeting nested spinbuttons radius can't reach -- matches DatePickerInputValue's identical exception.
TimePickerColumns's option buttons are a fixed circular/pill affordance distinct from the field's own surface, unrelated to TimePickerInput's radius prop.
TimePickerClock's dial face, hour/minute labels, and center dot are a fixed circular analog-clock affordance with no connection to TimePickerInput's radius prop.

inspirationNote: No shadcn/base-ui/dioxus-components/dioxus-primitives equivalent -- classified ADICO_ONLY_EXTRA, no upstream comparison possible.
